title: Causal and noncausal latent inference under missing neural observations
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Predict cursor x/y position and x/y velocity at every test timepoint under source-defined missing neural observations, separately for causal filtering and noncausal smoothing; retain full Figure 7e curves and Extended Data 6e–f comparisons.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Predict cursor x/y position and x/y velocity at every test timepoint under source-defined missing neural observations, separately for causal filtering and noncausal smoothing; retain full Figure 7e curves and Extended Data 6e–f comparisons.

Source-paper comparison for Complete source behavior-Pearson-CC curves by observed ratio and filtering/smoothing regime: Behavior Pearson CC on all test times, including missing-neural times: r_d=sum((y_d-mean(y_d))*(p_d-mean(p_d)))/sqrt(sum((y_d-mean(y_d))^2)*sum((p_d-mean(p_d))^2)), then arithmetic mean over four dimensions. Current author code maps NaN correlation to zero before the dimension mean; historical caller parity remains a separate binding gate. Higher is better.
success_criteria: Bind all original seven sessions, five folds, four behavior dimensions, complete ratio grid and mask identities; score every original test timepoint.
Compare a frozen candidate to independently rerun DFINE and the recovered paper curve under identical masks, preprocessing, readout selection and resource/access allowances.

Declare separate filtering and smoothing claims; any future observation used in the filtering path invalidates that claim. Retain LDM and SAE zero/neighbor-average controls at original 0.3/0.6 settings.

Meet the predeclared meaningful improvement and valid uncertainty rule across the original complete endpoint; reproduction, a new integrated-loss scalar, burst-dropout masks or a new split cannot constitute the paper win.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
participant_inputs: All public grid-reaching sessions/trials required by Figure7e and ED6e–f, spike/kinematic inputs under the identical frozen source-defined missingness masks; no published resultCSV or unmasked held neural values.
